title: PanKbase Differential Expression Browser
bodyHtml:
Explore interactive visualizations of differential gene expression within human pancreatic islets. Differential expression analyses were performed on pseudobulk analyses of our integrated single-cell RNA sequencing map featuring sequences from 140 human donors sourced from HPAP, IIDP, and Prodo. Of the 12 cell types in the integrated map, here we show differential expression results for the 6 cell types that are most abundant and have the highest statistical power for analysis. Because genes with low counts were pre-filtered, not all genes have results represented. See detailed differential expression methods here.  

For a selected dataset and comparison, visualize an interactive heatmap of the top 20 differentially expressed genes and interactive volcano plot of all differentially expressed genes. Hover for more information about each differentially expressed gene, and click to view details in the table below. In the table below, view differential expression results for all genes, upregulated genes, or downregulated genes. Type a gene name to search. Click "Show" in the Gene query column to obtain interactive violin plots and scatterplots. 

The differential expression analysis visualized on this page takes into account technical variation using a latent variable approach. For each cell type, learn how samples are distinguished based on variables by visiting the PCA Explorer.  

If you use data from this page, please review our Citation Policies to ensure proper citation of the underlying resource(s) used to generate these analyses.
